features.description: `dontpanic capabilities setup <id> --print-steps` planning surface. Reads the selected capability manifest and current status, then prints the ordered setup_steps[] with automatable/human-required labels, command templates, verification probes, and current readiness. No commands are executed in F001.
steps: Add capabilities setup subcommand parser with required capability_id and --print-steps.
Render ordered steps from setup_steps[] with status context from V0b capabilities status.
Refuse unknown capability ids with closest-match suggestion.
Add tests for Firebase, Linear, empty setup_steps, unknown id, and no-command execution.
features.acceptance: (1) `dontpanic capabilities setup firebase-dashboard --print-steps` renders all setup steps in order. (2) Human-required steps include reason text. (3) Automatable steps include command_template and verify_probe when present. (4) No commands execute. (5) Tests cover happy path and unknown id.

features.description: Governed automatable-step runner. `dontpanic capabilities setup <id> --automate-safe --confirm` executes only steps marked automatable=true and only when the command_template is allowlisted/safe. It skips human-required steps, records why, and re-runs verification probes after each attempted step.
steps: Define an allowlist policy for automatable command templates; default deny anything with shell metacharacters or secret placeholders.
Execute automatable steps one at a time with captured stdout/stderr summaries.
Re-run capability status/probes after attempted steps.
Add tests for allowlisted command, denied command, human-required skip, and confirm gate.
features.acceptance: (1) --automate-safe requires --confirm. (2) Human-required steps never execute. (3) Unsafe command templates are denied with explanation. (4) Allowlisted automatable steps execute in tests via fixture command runner. (5) Probes/status re-run after attempted steps. (6) Tests cover deny/allow/skip/confirm.

features.description: Setup evidence and roadmap close-out. Every setup run writes an operator-local evidence record summarizing attempted automatable steps, skipped human-required steps, statuses before/after, and next human actions. Parent roadmap is updated after V2 acceptance.
steps: Write setup-run evidence JSON under an operator-local DontPanic state path or plan evidence path when invoked during a plan.
Ensure evidence contains no secret values, only names/placeholders.
Add tests for evidence shape and sanitization-sensitive fields.
Update parent roadmap D-entry after V2 completion.
features.acceptance: (1) Setup run evidence records capability_id, attempted steps, skipped human-required steps, before/after status, and next actions. (2) No secret values are persisted. (3) Tests cover evidence shape. (4) Parent roadmap updated after V2 completion.
